Price element contains a 'visually-hidden' prefix span (Alennushinta/Normaalihinta) before the amount, e.g. '€59,90 EUR' — strip the hidden-label text. Confirmed in-stock classes: inventory--high and inventory--low, both mean in stock, text like 'Saatavilla 49' or 'Vain 1 jäljellä'. Scraper should treat products missing .product-item__inventory as out of stock, but this needs live validation against an actual out-of-stock item before trusting it.
